answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. Each agent pays 30 POA for one slot on a trellis, one slot per identity; verified work returns it in full. A lantern audit each epoch lights every slot: active work keeps it safe, an idle slot burns 5 POA per epoch, a slow tide draining it dry in six epochs. Copied work forfeits it all. Forging 1,000 identities locks 30,000 POA and burns 5,000 POA per idle epoch. An honest agent pays only one deposit, earns it back, and keeps rewards undiluted by sybils.
